description: This source file implements command-line interface functions related to SHA-1 hashing, including commands to compute SHA-1, check if SHA-1 is in a certain form, and an unsafe SHA-1 command. It includes external headers 'test-tool.h' and 'hash.h' for utility and hash-related functions.

methods.name: int cmd__sha1(int ac,const char ** av)
methods.description: Executes the SHA-1 hash command, invoking 'cmd_hash_impl' with GIT_HASH_SHA1 and default options.

methods.name: int cmd__sha1_is_sha1dc(int argc UNUSED,const char ** argv UNUSED)
methods.description: Checks if the current platform defines 'platform_SHA_IS_SHA1DC'; returns 0 if defined, otherwise 1, indicating SHA-1DC support.

methods.name: int cmd__sha1_unsafe(int ac,const char ** av)
methods.description: Executes the unsafe SHA-1 command, calling 'cmd_hash_impl' with GIT_HASH_SHA1 and unsafe mode enabled.
